easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and the ability granted to it by Doom Weaver trigger.
Resolve the trigger from the ability granted by Doom Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability and Olivia trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Doom Weaver
uses.cardState: is paired with the persist creature
